title: Pan-Seared Lamb Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish originating from Norway, combining lamb with unique spices and pungent herbs.

ingredients.name: Pungent herbs (such as thyme and rosemary)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb leg steaks for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Remove the lamb from the pan and set aside to rest.
Add the pilaf mix to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the unique spice blend and pungent herbs to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
Return the lamb to the pan and stir to combine with the pilaf mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
